title: Swing the hanging role label
context: The owner requested an infinite animation for the role label and approved the recommended gentle pendulum swing.
options: Loop a small rotation around the top-right corner
choice: Use a five-second CSS rotation loop between -3 and 4 degrees, starting at the existing 2-degree tilt. Enable it only in full motion mode with no system reduced-motion preference.
tradeoff: The label introduces continuous decorative motion as an explicit exception to the quiet-by-default rules. Reduced-motion, lite mode and print retain the static label.
